cue_rules.topic_change_candidate: (?i)\b(inny temat|zmian[aę] tematu|a teraz|wróćmy|wrocmy|by the way|another topic|back to|next question)\b

selection: Within provider and text-length tertile, select two whole families greedily for uncovered structural/cue features, then bounded cue diversity, tie by canonical source hash. Prefer at least two unexposed candidates for provisional validation; known prior exposure and family unions prevent validation assignment. All selection is DEV/exploratory, never sealed blind.
split_policy: Whole connected family components only; union same provider conversation ID, canonical object, shared native node/message ID, or exact role-bound text >= configured threshold. Exclude components overlapping historical panel. Mark known prior model/retrieval evaluation exposure tuning. Provisional validation is not certified independent.
attachments: Retain original archive unchanged; copy available binaries linked by prior attachment manifest to selected conversations, retain all embedded records and unresolved-reference entries privately.
transformation: No inference; exact native object and fields retained. Normalized text is an explicitly lossy projection for cues and views; source graph and raw remain authoritative. No synthetic phenomena or assistant-authored new checkpoints.
